name: Oudtshoorn Central
tagline: The grid town with the feather palaces
description: The compact centre around High Street and Baron van Reede, with the sandstone buildings the ostrich feather boom paid for, the CP Nel Museum, the supermarkets and most of the guesthouses. It is walkable, which nothing else in the Klein Karoo is.
bestFor: Anyone without a vehicle or wanting services on the doorstep
pros: Feather palace architecture and the museum
Supermarkets, banks and the hospital nearby
cons: Quiet after dark with little open
Load shedding hits the whole town equally

name: Schoemanshoek
tagline: The guesthouse valley on the road to the caves
description: The green valley running north from town towards the Cango Caves, lined with guest farms, small vineyards and ostrich operations along the Grobbelaars River. It is the prettiest place to stay in the district and about fifteen minutes from the centre.
bestFor: Anyone with a car who wants space, quiet and a garden
pros: Green valley setting with mountain views
Guest farms with pools and space
On the road to the Cango Caves
cons: Internet depends entirely on the property

name: Cango Valley and the Swartberg Foothills
tagline: Under the mountains at the top of the valley
description: The upper end of the valley below the Swartberg range, where the caves are and where the pass over the mountains begins. Accommodation is sparse and scenic, and the road up to the Swartberg Pass, a national monument, starts within a few kilometres.
bestFor: Hikers and drivers here for the pass and the caves
pros: Swartberg Pass and the Cango Caves at hand
cons: Half an hour from the town
Very limited accommodation and no shops

name: De Rust
tagline: The village at the mouth of the Meiringspoort gorge
description: A small village about thirty-five minutes east on Route 62, at the entrance to the Meiringspoort gorge that cuts through the Swartberg. It has a handful of guesthouses, a farm stall and almost nothing else, which is precisely the appeal for some people.
bestFor: Anyone wanting complete quiet on the Route 62 corridor
pros: Cheaper than the Oudtshoorn guest farms
cons: Nothing to do beyond the landscape
